coverage_override.reason: OCR damaged the visible bullet numerals, but text and Lua establish the 2/3/4/5 thresholds. The material procedure, threshold framework, three defensive thresholds, unnumbered summon lock, and five-material activated effect are audited separately; battle/effect indestructibility remains one printed bullet.

effects.lua_implementation: EnableReviveLimit and AddFusionProcFunRep2 require two through ninety-nine Cyberse materials with 0 ATK and either 0 DEF or no DEF because they are Link Monsters.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Extra Deck procedure accepts two or more filtered materials and grants effects based on material count.

effects.printed_clause: This card gains effects based on the number of materials with 0 ATK and DEF (or no DEF) used for its Fusion Summon.
effects.lua_implementation: EFFECT_MATERIAL_CHECK counts the qualifying actual materials and stores the number in a standard-reset flag label; each threshold condition reads that stored value.

official_references.matched_structure: Official card enables distinct effects according to the number of materials used.

effects.printed_clause: 2+: This card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: At two or more stored materials, paired EFFECT_INDESTRUCTABLE_BATTLE and EFFECT_INDESTRUCTABLE_EFFECT single effects return 1.

official_references.matched_structure: Official monster registers battle- and effect-destruction protection for a compound indestructibility clause.

effects.printed_clause: 3+: This card cannot be targeted by your opponent's card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: At three or more stored materials, single-range EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET uses aux.tgoval to reject opponent-owned effects.

official_references.matched_structure: Official monster uses EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET with opponent-only effect targeting protection.

effects.printed_clause: 4+: This card is unaffected by card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: At four or more stored materials, single-range EFFECT_IMMUNE_EFFECT returns true for card effects.

official_references.matched_structure: Official unaffected monster registers broad EFFECT_IMMUNE_EFFECT while in the Monster Zone.

effects.printed_clause: If this card was Fusion Summoned this turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of the turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The player-targeted MZONE EFFECT_CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON now applies whenever this card is Fusion Summoned and has STATUS_SPSUMMON_TURN. It no longer checks the material count, so the unnumbered lock applies after every Fusion Summon of this card while the continuous effect remains active.

official_references.matched_structure: Official card uses summon-type plus STATUS_SPSUMMON_TURN checks for an effect active during the turn the Extra Deck monster was summoned.
Official effect imposes a player-targeted EFFECT_CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON restriction for the turn.

effects.issue: Fixed: removed the unprinted four-material requirement from lockcon; only Fusion Summon type and current Summon-turn status remain.

effects.printed_clause: 5+: Once while face-up on the field: You can banish 1 Cyberse monster from your GY; destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
effects.lua_implementation: At five or more stored materials, an MZONE Ignition effect with soft SetCountLimit(1) banishes one Necrovalley-valid Cyberse monster from the GY as cost and non-target-destroys one opposing card. The soft count resets only after leaving and returning, matching once while face-up.

official_references.card_name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
official_references.matched_structure: Official location-restricted Ignition effect pays a GY banish cost and removes an opposing card with once-per-face-up behavior.
